title: 허생전
prompt:
INPUT: the attached image is the approved character (beginning form); keep her.

BOOK: «허생전» by 박지원. comedy and satire · 17세기 효종 무렵의 조선(18세기 작) · 한양 남산 묵적골 → 안성 → 제주 → 빈 섬. Source scope: "『열하일기』 「옥갑야화」에 실린 허생 이야기 전체".

STYLE: 섬세한 선화 + 회화적 채색의 성인 판타지 삽화풍

Design notes in quotes may be written in Korean; read them as description, never render them as text.

AGE: keep her age as in the attached image; add no wrinkles, folds or under-eye shadows, even when she smiles.

GARMENT: whatever the form changes, keep her garment structure: an overlapping robe.

FORM — ENDING (결말): "빈 섬의 주인 — 바닷바람에 날리는 쪽빛 도포, 은 꾸러미를 쥔 손". Battle role: attacker. This is the answer stage of her story.

HOLD BACK: these climactic scenes belong to the open images — keep their creatures and events out of this portrait's setting, even as a distant figure, statue, painting or reflection: "비 새는 남산골 오두막, 쌓인 책 더미와 빈 쌀독"; "안성 장터에 산처럼 쌓인 과일 궤짝과 텅 빈 제사 장터"; "빈 섬 앞바다, 햇빛에 반짝이며 가라앉는 은덩이". An object named in FORM or in her pose stays.

EXPOSURE (bold): her outer layer (coat, cloak, robe or armor) stays on both shoulders, worn symmetrically; skin shows through the inner garment — a deep open neckline with natural cleavage, a fitted corset-like waist, slits where the form allows. The collar opens with the neckline in a V or folds down, never standing away from the neck. Nothing slipped off. Chest and pelvis covered; keep the FORM costume, material and palette.

PRESENTATION: a refined, glamorous adult fantasy card illustration — a beautiful, polished face within her FACE structure; a dense, high-detail costume where decorative metal or gold accents (trim, clasps, a breastplate or corset, jewelry) frame the book material without replacing it; warm dramatic backlight with a rim light and strong value contrast.

STANCE (this form): "뱃전에 서서 은 꾸러미를 바다로 힘껏 던지는 자세" — a poised card pose seen from a slightly low camera, held still and easy to read.

EXPRESSION (ENDING): flat level brows, half-lidded deadpan stare, mouth in a straight unmoved line — the mood of this stage. This expression replaces the attached image's; keep only who she is.

OUTPUT: the ending form of the woman in the attached image, as a new card image. Keep her face, eye and hair colors, haircut, skin tone, body proportions and palette; change only her costume and bearing, as FORM says. Do not reuse the attached image's outer garment, coat, cape or lining artwork — build the costume FORM describes, keeping only her material and palette. Vertical 2:3 frame (1024×1536), full body with head and feet inside the frame and clear margins, nothing in front of her but what she holds, face toward the camera (front or three-quarter, never a back view). A new card-ready pose is fine.

ONE FIGURE ONLY. No second character, no text, no lettering, no logo, no watermark, no speech bubble, no frame border; pages and spines stay unlettered.

ANATOMY: natural adult proportions, about 7.5 heads tall — height from the legs, never a smaller head or a longer neck. The neck is a natural length and the head sits close to the shoulders. No body-part enlargement, no extra limbs.

BODY: a normal human body — one head, two arms and two legs, each joined at its natural joint; elbows, knees and wrists bend the human way. Hands and feet may be partly hidden by the pose, what she holds or the frame.

HANDS: natural human hands. Her hands do only what STANCE says and hold only what it names. Her hands keep the same gloves or bare hands as in the attached image.
